entries.body:
R1: board empty; logs routine. changes r01: CHG-111 PROPOSED batch off-peak; CHG-113 APPLIED checkout-api build 4.33.8 sets feature.batch_size=0 (round-01/changes.md:4, suspect BAD_CONFIG, no errors seen yet); CHG-114 APPLIED inventory-svc 4.33.8 no config.
R2: board: follow-ups OPEN VENDOR_TICKET, POSTMORTEM_DRAFT (round-02/board.md:3-4). changes: CHG-116 log sampling health 1%. pricing-svc ERROR 429 upstream=sms-gateway (round-02/logs/pricing-svc.log:4,6,12).
R3: board Thread A opened UPSTREAM_RATE_LIMIT pricing-svc + search-api, ongoing (round-03/board.md:3). 429s pricing-svc.log:4,7-9; search-api.log:8. No changes.md r03.
R4: board Thread B opened inventory-svc suspected CERT_EXPIRED ongoing (round-04/board.md:3); follow-up OPEN CAPACITY_REVIEW (board.md:4). changes CHG-131 APPLIED TLS session ticket rotation hourly. BUT logs show inventory-svc ERROR dns lookup failed host=kms.internal SERVFAIL (round-04/logs/inventory-svc.log:16,20,34,39,44,64,70) -> real cause likely DNS_RESOLUTION. 429s continue pricing-svc.log:11-58, search-api.log:10-78.
R5: no board updates; changes CHG-137 dashboards. errors: pricing-svc 429 sms-gateway (round-05/logs/pricing-svc.log:1,7,12,21); checkout-api WARN slow query orders (r05 checkout-api.log:12-68); inventory slow query events.
R6: board Thread A mitigated (round-06/board.md:3); VENDOR_TICKET CLOSED (board.md:4). CHG-150 APPLIED mitigation thread A pricing-svc (round-06/changes.md:4). r06 no 429s; inventory-svc dns SERVFAIL kms.internal continues (round-06/logs/inventory-svc.log:3,8,11,19). Open follow-ups: POSTMORTEM_DRAFT, CAPACITY_REVIEW.
R7: board Thread B cause revised to DNS_RESOLUTION (round-07/board.md:3); Thread D opened MEMORY_LEAK pricing-svc ongoing (round-07/board.md:4). CHG-153 PROPOSED only. Logs: inventory-svc dns SERVFAIL kms.internal (round-07/logs/inventory-svc.log:1,3,21,29,31).
R8: board Thread A resolved (round-08/board.md:3); follow-up OPEN DATA_BACKFILL (board.md:4). CHG-157 log sampling only. inventory dns SERVFAIL kms.internal continues (round-08/logs/inventory-svc.log:6,21). pricing-svc heap usage high rss 3048 (round-08/logs/pricing-svc.log:4). Open follow-ups: POSTMORTEM_DRAFT, CAPACITY_REVIEW, DATA_BACKFILL. Next: advance to R9.
